business_summary: OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a distributor of medical equipment and pharmaceuticals in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Medical Equipment Business, Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business, and Nursing Care Products Business. The Medical Equipment Business segment engages in the wholesale of medical equipment comprising artificial joints, coronary stents, steel instruments, osteosynthesis materials made of metal and ceramics, ultrasonic scalpels, and pacemakers and catheters related to examination, diagnosis, and treatment of the heart and blood vessels; X-ray fluoroscopy and CT equipment for tumor and embolism treatment, and endoscopes for cancer treatment; and diagnostic imaging equipment, such as MRI and CT to ventilators, and intraoperative monitors, as well as operating room equipment, including shadowless lights. This segment also offers reagents and equipment for genetic research, cell culture, and protein analysis; automatic analyzers for biochemical, immunological, and blood; and test reagents, as well as undertakes services for DNA analysis in the field of life sciences. The Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business segment provides inventory management, medical material masters and data analysis, and purchase management services. The Nursing Care Products Business segment engages in the sale and rental of nursing care equipment; the sale of welfare equipment, such as portable toilets and bathing chairs; and home renovation works, as well as provides nursing care services. The company was formerly known as OLBA HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS, Inc. and changed its name to OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc. in September 2026. OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 일본에서 의료 장비 및 의약품 유통업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 이 회사는 의료 장비 사업, 특수 제품 배송(SPD) 사업, 간호 제품 사업의 세 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 의료기기 사업부문은 심장 및 혈관의 검사, 진단 및 치료와 관련된 인공 관절, 관상동맥 스텐트, 강철 기구, 금속 및 세라믹으로 만든 골합성 재료, 초음파 메스, 심장 박동기 및 카테터로 구성된 의료 장비 도매를 영위합니다. 종양 및 색전증 치료를 위한 X선 투시 및 CT 장비, 암 치료를 위한 내시경; MRI, CT 등의 진단 영상 장비부터 인공호흡기, 수술 중 모니터, 무영광을 포함한 수술실 장비까지. 이 부문은 또한 유전 연구, 세포 배양 및 단백질 분석을 위한 시약 및 장비를 제공합니다. 생화학, 면역학, 혈액 자동 분석기; 생명과학 분야의 DNA 분석 서비스를 비롯해 테스트 시약 등을 취급하고 있습니다. 특산품 배송(SPD) 버스
